findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] app/apis/admin/utils.py:22 invokes subprocess.run with an argument list (['df','-h',mount_point]) and no shell, so shell metacharacters in the mount point carry no meaning and no command string is ever assembled from input. Hardening around it: a 5s timeout, a scrubbed env pinning PATH=/usr/bin:/bin so binary resolution is not inherited, cwd='/', stdin=DEVNULL, and an exception handler that logs detail server-side while returning a generic 500 with no command string or traceback. Alternative mitigation accepted: argv-list execution without a shell achieves the same special-element neutralisation as the CM's character allow-list | verdict=pass confidence=high
